objects.name: project_note_revision
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_note_revision ON note_versions(project_id,notes_revision) WHERE scope='project'

objects.name: recording_note_revision
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recording_note_revision ON note_versions(recording_id,notes_revision) WHERE scope='recording'

objects.name: recordings_collection
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX recordings_collection ON recordings(collection_id)

objects.name: results_recording
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX results_recording ON transcript_results(recording_id)

objects.name: runtime_batch_compatible
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX runtime_batch_compatible ON runtime_batch_runs (compatibility_hash,admission,state,created,id)

objects.name: runtime_members_recording
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX runtime_members_recording ON runtime_batch_members(recording_id,batch_id)

objects.name: runtime_one_live_attempt
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_one_live_attempt ON runtime_batch_attempts(job_id) WHERE state NOT IN ('complete','failed','cancelled')

objects.name: annotation_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE annotation_items (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES annotation_runs(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0),
                origin TEXT NOT NULL, suggestion TEXT, suggestion_sha256 TEXT,
                created TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(run_id,sequence), UNIQUE(run_id,request_id)
            )

objects.name: annotation_review_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE annotation_review_events (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES annotation_items(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
                predecessor_id TEXT REFERENCES annotation_review_events(id),
                payload TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('accepted','rejected')),
                action TEXT NOT NULL, actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT,
                observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(item_id,revision), UNIQUE(item_id,request_id)
            )

objects.name: annotation_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE annotation_runs (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, recording_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0),
                result_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transcript_results(id),
                source_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES result_versions(id),
                source_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                codebook_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES codebook_versions(id),
                codebook_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                passage_ids TEXT NOT NULL, producer TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(recording_id,sequence), UNIQUE(recording_id,request_id)
            )

objects.name: codebook_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE codebook_versions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0),
                predecessor_id TEXT REFERENCES codebook_versions(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL,
                actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, UNIQUE(project_id,sequence)
            )

objects.name: collections
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE collections (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, recording_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings(id)
                    ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
                    progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    params TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', chunks TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL
                )

objects.name: native_batch_runs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE native_batch_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', params TEXT NOT NULL, members TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: note_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE note_versions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, recording_id TEXT REFERENCES recordings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('project','recording')),
                notes_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(notes_revision>=0),
                text TEXT NOT NULL, text_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT,
                CHECK((scope='project' AND recording_id IS NULL) OR
                      (scope='recording' AND recording_id IS NOT NULL))
            )

objects.name: projects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE projects (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL
                , classification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', storage_dir TEXT, notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', notes_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

objects.name: providers
recordings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE recordings (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
                    ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL,
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'audio', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preparing',
                    duration REAL, segments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    speakers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created TEXT NOT NULL
                , active_transcript_id TEXT, provider_id TEXT REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', notes_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, original_input TEXT)

objects.name: result_hints
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE result_hints (result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES transcript_results(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, hints TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: result_trash
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE result_trash (result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES transcript_results(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,trashed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: result_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE result_versions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, result_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transcript_results(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0),
                predecessor_id TEXT REFERENCES result_versions(id),
                source_version_id TEXT REFERENCES result_versions(id),
                payload TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                action TEXT NOT NULL, context TEXT NOT NULL, actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                reason TEXT, UNIQUE(result_id,sequence)
            )

objects.name: runtime_batch_attempts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE runtime_batch_attempts (job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runtime_batch_members(job_id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reserved', input_receipt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', remote_receipt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', error_code TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,attempt))

objects.name: runtime_batch_members
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE runtime_batch_members (job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runtime_batch_runs(id), recording_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, source_identity TEXT NOT NULL, current_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', result_id TEXT, output_receipt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(batch_id,ordinal))

objects.name: runtime_batch_runs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE runtime_batch_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, compatibility_hash TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', admission TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', membership_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, seal_revision INTEGER, seal_digest TEXT, coordinator_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, journal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: settings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: transcript_results
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE transcript_results (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, recording_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings(id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE, label TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL,
                segments TEXT NOT NULL, speakers TEXT NOT NULL,
                job_id TEXT UNIQUE, created TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL
            )
